description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. Dit is jouw team Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens; De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! Dit breng je mee Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector; Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken; Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden; Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter! description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success
Data Engineer 
 
About Mirakl
 
Mirakl is the leading provider of eCommerce software solutions. Mirakl's suite of solutions provides enterprises with a transformative way to drive significant growth and efficiency in their online business.
Since 2012, Mirakl has been pioneering the platform economy, empowering retail and B2B enterprises with the most advanced, secure, and scalable technology to digitize and expand product assortment through marketplace and dropship, improve efficiency in supplier catalog management and payments, personalize shopping experiences, and boost profits through retail media.
 
In July 2025, Mirakl launched Mirakl Nexus, the first neutral infrastructure designed for agentic commerce. Built on Mirakl's 13 years of expertise and innovation, and powered by an ecosystem of more than 100,000 sellers, Mirakl Nexus connects merchants and AI agents to automate product discovery, payments, and after-sales service.
 
For more information: www.mirakl.com.
 
This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.
 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard, Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control
  • Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)
  • Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team
  • Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics
  • Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment
  • Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems
  • Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem
  • Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks
  • Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)
  • Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences
 

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required) 
 

6. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 1 hour discussion with your futur manager 
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.
Want to learn more about how we build our AI infrastructure? Read our latest article: Open source at the core, proprietary where it counts: Mirakl's AI inference platform — by Jeanine Harb, Antoine Bourgault and Maxime Roodnejad, Senior Data Engineers at Mirakl.

description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What is the role?

Roku's Content Distribution team drives strategic growth by sourcing, negotiating, and closing distribution partnerships with leading streaming video providers and major TV networks. As Director, Content Distribution, UK, you will lead strategy and execution for Roku's content distribution business in the UK. You will directly own high-value, complex negotiations with local public service broadcasters (PSBs), operators, and digital distributors, and guide the long-term roadmap for partner acquisition, renewals, and revenue expansion in the market.

This role requires a senior leader with a proven track record of closing large, strategic content deals, deep expertise in streaming and subscription business models, and established C-level relationships across the UK media industry. You will shape how Roku is perceived by the local media community and represent Roku in the UK and EU. 

 

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they’ve used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

Strategic Leadership & Deal Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end negotiation of major content distribution, premium subscription, and advertising inventory deals with UK PSBs (e.g., BBC, ITV, Channel 4), operators, and SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and premium channel providers
  • Own the strategic vision, roadmap, and financial performance of UK Content Distribution, including revenue management, ensuring sustained partner and revenue growth
  • Serve as the primary executive-level relationship owner for key UK partners, driving alignment on long-term collaboration, business strategy, and deal expansion opportunities
  • Negotiate advertising arrangements, including ad inventory splits, revenue shares, and backfill agreements

Business Development & Deal Structuring

  • Lead all aspects of new partner development, including sourcing, financial modeling, forecasting, term-sheet creation, contract drafting, negotiations, and closing
  • Own renewal strategy for the installed base of UK contracts, including re-negotiating major deals and developing a plan to upgrade existing Roku partnerships to the next level, in partnership with Roku's Legal team
  • Provide cross-functional leadership to legal, finance, marketing, product, and ad sales teams throughout negotiations and ongoing partnership management

Analytics, Strategy, & Executive Communications

  • Develop and present strategic materials, including deal strategies, quarterly updates, executive level presentations, and analysis of the UK media landscape and broader industry trends
  • Evaluate potential channel partners using deep analysis of content value, market demand and appeal, competitive positioning, financial modeling, and long-term strategic fit
  • Continuously analyze current channel applications and competitor lineups to prioritize channel onboarding
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive dynamics, and the evolving UK streaming ecosystem to inform Roku's content distribution strategy
  • Support the content acquisition team by researching content trends, identifying ad innovations, and recommending new partners

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee the lifecycle of UK partner contracts, including compliance, renewals, and operational optimization
  • Build and mentor a high-performing team focused on complex negotiations, partner management, and business performance
  • Establish scalable processes to manage a large and diverse portfolio of partners

 

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 10+ years of experience in content distribution, business development, or media partnerships at a leading broadcaster, operator, streaming platform, or media company, including direct ownership of major deal negotiations
  • A proven, high-level network of traditional and digital media executives across the UK, including direct experience working with C-level leaders
  • Deep understanding of subscription streaming models, linear licensing agreements, and advertising economics, including the UK advertising ecosystem, ad inventory pricing and structures, and direct, programmatic, and audience-based monetization
  • Extensive experience working with legal teams on complex distribution agreements
  • Strong executive presence and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships with senior and mid-level leaders, internally and externally
  • Demonstrated excellence in financial modeling, competitive analysis, and strategic decision-making
  • Revenue management experience, and experience working with media sales teams
  • A demonstrated passion for the UK media landscape and a solid understanding of streaming media technologies
  • Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and managing multiple high-impact deals simultaneously, with 5+ years of people management experience
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA, JD, or similar advanced degree preferred
#LI-OR1

 

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

 

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

About the role 

NinjaOne is a unified IT operations platform for endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and security, used by IT teams and managed service providers (MSPs) worldwide. Cybersecurity and data regulation, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and DORA, now shapes how our German-speaking customers and partners buy and operate IT tooling. 

As Director of Government Affairs, you will be NinjaOne's principal voice in Germany and at the EU level. Your priority is to build trusted relationships and shape the debate in the institutions where German cybersecurity and economic policy is discussed, above all the Wirtschaftsrat der CDU e.V. and the Cyber-Sicherheitsrat Deutschland e.V.. You will also represent NinjaOne in Brussels, with EU institutions and EU-level trade associations, in coordination with our global policy team. 

Location: Berlin, Germany 

 

What You'll be Doing

Germany engagement (primary focus) 

  • Build and run NinjaOne's government affairs strategy for Germany and the EU, aligned with global priorities and EMEA growth goals
  • Hold an active role in the Wirtschaftsrat der CDU and the Cyber-Sicherheitsrat Deutschland, including working groups, committees, and sponsorship decisions
  • Develop relationships across parties and institutions: Bundestag committees (digital, economic affairs, interior), federal ministries, state governments, and the BSI
  • Engage trade associations such as Bitkom, eco, BDI, and BITMi, and identify where NinjaOne should lead, join, or sponsor
  • Represent NinjaOne at political events, parliamentary evenings, banquets, conferences, and roundtables. Evening and weekend commitments are expected

Policy shaping 

  • Draft position papers, consultation responses, amendments, and briefings on cybersecurity, data protection, digital resilience, and software supply chain topics
  • Advocate on German implementation of NIS2 and on the CRA, DORA, GDPR, and AI Act, with attention to how they affect endpoint management and MSP delivery models
  • Coordinate with Brussels-based associations and global colleagues so that German positions and EU-level positions stay consistent

EU engagement 

  • Build relationships with the European Commission, European Parliament, and Council, and with ENISA, on files that affect endpoint management and MSP delivery models
  • Take part in EU-level trade bodies such as DIGITALEUROPE, and in Commission consultations and expert groups
  • Work with our global policy team to keep German and EU positions consistent

Business partnership and advisory 

  • Brief executives, Legal, Product, Security, and Sales on regulatory developments and their business impact
  • Partner with Business Development on public sector and regulated-industry opportunities, while keeping advocacy separate from sales activity
  • Work with Marketing and Communications on German-language policy messaging, speaking opportunities, and thought leadership

Governance 

  • Keep all activity compliant with the German Lobbyregister, the EU Transparency Register, and NinjaOne's anti-corruption, gifts, and hospitality policies
  • Manage the government affairs budget, memberships, and external advisors, and report on activities and outcomes
  • Other duties as needed 

 

About You

Required 

  • 8 to 12 years of experience in government affairs, public policy, regulatory affairs, or political advocacy, with meaningful time in technology, cybersecurity, or another regulated industry. 
  • A record of influencing policy, such as drafting amendments, leading coalitions, or shaping consultation outcomes, rather than only monitoring it. 
  • Working relationships or demonstrated access in German political and institutional circles, ideally including the Wirtschaftsrat der CDU, the Cyber-Sicherheitsrat Deutschland, Bundestag committees, federal ministries, or the BSI. 
  • Solid knowledge of the German and EU cybersecurity and data regulatory landscape (NIS2, CRA, GDPR, DORA, AI Act), and working knowledge of how EU institutions and policy processes operate. 
  • Experience with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, energy, telecom, public sector, or critical infrastructure. 
  • Comfort and credibility at political receptions, banquets, and parliamentary events. 
  • Native-level German (C2) and fluent business English. 
  • Strong drafting skills for policy documents, in German and English. 
  • Willingness to travel regularly, and the right to work in Germany. 

Preferred 

  • Experience in EU-level lobbying groups or trade bodies (for example DIGITALEUROPE, or a Brussels-based public affairs firm or association). 
  • In-house government affairs or public policy experience at a comparable SaaS or cybersecurity company, such as CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, or similar. 
  • Prior role in a parliamentary office, ministry, regulator, political party, or public affairs consultancy. 
  • Familiarity with the MSP and SME IT ecosystem. 
  • Advanced degree in law, political science, public policy, economics, or a related field. 
  • Experience managing external consultants. 
  • Familiarity with ENISA, the Commission's consultation process, and EU cybersecurity certification schemes. 

What helps you succeed 

  • Credibility with senior officials and the judgment to stay discreet and non-partisan. 
  • The ability to translate technical issues into policy language, and the reverse. 
  • Independence and comfort working with limited supervision. 

 

What You’ll Love

  • Grow personally and professionally with one of the fastest growing companies
  • Enjoy your lunch covered by NinjaOne 3 times/week at the office
  • Access to our Corporate Benefits Platform (with discounts for brands such as Expedia, FitX, Zalando and many more)
  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
  • Receive competitive compensation
  • Collaborate with a curious, kind, international and intercultural workforce
  • Enjoy your work environment with its location in the heart of Berlin, directly at the Alexanderplatz (close to all transit)

description:
RDQ427R369

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.
  • Make agentic development the default path: Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.
  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.
  • Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence: Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.
  • Treat backward compatibility as a product feature: Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.
  • Lead across the platform: Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.

What we look for:

  • 3+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.
  • A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.
  • A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.

Your Role in Our Story: 

As our Enterprise Architecture, you will play a key role in shaping ACT's technology direction as we continue to grow our global trading business and expand our digital capabilities.You'll take ownership of our enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring that our technology platforms, systems and investments work together to support business growth. Working at Group level, you'll reporting to Global IT Director and partner closely with senior leadership to influence strategic decisions, bring alignment across teams and build a scalable technology landscape for the future. In essence, your role involves:

  • Shape our enterprise architecture strategy: Define and drive a clear technology vision and roadmap across business, applications, data and technology, aligned with ACT's commercial priorities.
  • Drive alignment across the Group: Ensure technology initiatives and platforms work together, reducing complexity, duplication and fragmented solutions.
  • Lead architecture governance: Establish principles and standards, guide key architecture decisions and challenge investments where needed to ensure long-term scalability and business value.
  • Influence strategic technology investments: Advise senior leadership on technology priorities, platform choices and opportunities to optimise our technology landscape.
  • Enable business and digital growth: Support the development of integrated platforms and client-facing digital solutions, ensuring technology can scale alongside the business.
  • Build and develop architecture capabilities: Strengthen the enterprise architecture function, coach and develop expertise, and collaborate closely with engineering, data, security and business leaders.
  • Act as a strategic business partner: Work directly with the COO, Global IT Director and other senior stakeholders, translating business ambitions into practical technology direction.

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes:

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. A Master's degree in technology or business is an advantage.
  • 10–15 years of progressive experience in architecture and technology, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
  • Proven ability to define and drive enterprise architecture strategy, governance and roadmaps across complex organisations, while influencing executive stakeholders.
  • Deep expertise across business, application, data and integration architecture, including cloud platforms, APIs and modern design patterns.
  • Solid knowledge of established frameworks and methodologies, such as TOGAF and business-capability modelling, with the ability to apply them pragmatically.
  • A track record of technology portfolio rationalisation, reducing complexity, identifying consolidation opportunities and optimising investments.
  • Strong commercial judgment, translating technical decisions into measurable business value while balancing cost, scalability, risk and speed to market.
  • Collaborative and influential leadership style, with experience building architecture capabilities, coaching teams and driving change across an organisation.
  • Background in trading, financial services, commodities or other data-intensive, regulated environments is highly advantageous, alongside experience architecting integrated, client-facing digital platforms.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

About Capco

Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry.

We're looking for a senior software engineer with strong ML and GenAI skills to deliver end-to-end machine learning solutions for our financial services clients. You'll own the full lifecycle — from data pipelines and model development through production deployment and monitoring — working autonomously in complex, regulated environments.

This is your chance to make a real difference! 

YOUR CAPCO DAY 

  • Design and build end-to-end data pipelines and feature engineering workflows on large-scale transactional data in regulated client environments
  • Train, calibrate, and validate ML models — supervised, unsupervised, and ensemble — including threshold analysis and production-grade explainability
  • Develop GenAI-powered solutions such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, and LLM-based automation to accelerate knowledge-intensive client processes
  • Deploy and monitor models in production with drift detection, performance tracking, and multi-environment release management (Dev → Staging → Prod)
  • Work directly with client stakeholders — from compliance SMEs to engineering teams — delivering documentation, knowledge transfer, and long-term enablement

 

YOUR CAPCO FIT

  • Strong software engineering foundation: Python, Spark, CI/CD, containerized deployments (Kubernetes), and production-grade pipeline orchestration (Airflow or equivalent)
  • Data Science depth: feature engineering at scale, statistical modeling, experiment design, model explainability (e.g. Shapley Values), and threshold calibration under business constraints
  • Hands-on ML experience: tree-based methods, neural networks, ensemble design, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and out-of-time testing
  • Practical GenAI experience: LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows for automating knowledge-intensive processes
  • Fluent German and strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to produce audit-ready documentation for regulated environments

 

Ready to take the Next Step 

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.  This is an opportunity to make a difference and contribute to a highly successful company with a significant growth trajectory.

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

Confidence with data: pulling analysis, running cohort studies, and building dashboards. Experience designing and running rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments. Strong instincts for user experience and a focus on sustainable long-term strategies. Ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams without formal authority, including with commercial, GTM and operations counterparts. Hands-on experience building products using AI/LLMs to generate or personalise content. AI Builder mindset with experience of using AI as your engine to drive repeatable and automated systems, processes and artefacts that create step changes in performance and efficiencies. Strong signals we look for: Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) in a B2B context. Experience designing personalisation systems, including data models and trigger logic. Previous work in a company that has scaled from hundreds to thousands of users. A point of view on where AI genuinely improves outcomes versus creating noise. Drivers, Not Passengers: You think in systems, take completion seriously, and raise bad news as quickly as good. AI to Deliver Outcomes: You have a bias for action (ship, measure, iterate) and ask "how would AI help do this?" before scoping the work. description: Our Vision & Products 🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first. And we’re only just getting started! Our Team We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role Most LLM roles stop at experimentation. Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users. Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better. You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production. The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles. If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role. Key Responsibilities Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible Your Qualifications You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature Fine-tuning is core to your experience Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence You can take work beyond notebooks into production You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system Bonus points Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI Multilingual LLMs Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing Multimodal models Open-source LLM / post-training contributions Why EverAI? 📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond 🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it 🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance 🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship 👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity 🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale What We Offer ✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact 📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work 🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together ❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members) 🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected 📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications 💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD ⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows 🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with. We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business. If that’s you — reach out and apply! To learn how we collect and use your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Applicant Privacy Notice. description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register. We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to lead and grow our EMEA Customer Success team, helping n8n's most strategic enterprise customers drive adoption, retention, and expansion while scaling the team and operating model for our next stage of growth. You'll start with a team of 4 CSMs, which will grow in line with our 2027 hiring plans. To make that happen, you'll combine hands-on customer leadership, deliberate people development, and strong operational execution: LEAD OUR MOST STRATEGIC ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS IN EMEA Partner with CSMs to navigate complex customer challenges and develop strategies for the region's largest and highest-risk enterprise accounts. Build trusted executive relationships with key customers and step directly into customer conversations when additional leadership is needed. Stay hands-on with strategic accounts while the team scales, including personally owning customer relationships where needed. BUILD AND DEVELOP A HIGH-PERFORMING EMEA TEAM Hire and onboard the additional CSMs needed as the EMEA team grows, building on the strong team already in place. Coach and develop your team through structured 1:1s, clear development plans, and deliberate skill-building. Create a high-accountability, supportive environment where people receive clear feedback and can continuously raise the bar. Lead a distributed team across multiple countries and time zones. DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE Run a consistent operating cadence across forecasting, account health, and structured risk reviews. Build repeatable Customer Success motions across onboarding, QBRs, adoption, retention, and expansion. Use customer and team insights to identify risks early, raise issues proactively, and continuously improve how the team operates. SHAPE THE CUSTOMER JOURNEY WITH CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERS Partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, TAMs, Renewals, and GTM leaders to deliver a strong end-to-end customer experience. Collaborate with Customer Success leaders across the US, DACH, and Scaled CS to evolve shared playbooks and ways of working. Contribute to global CS initiatives and help build scalable methodologies as n8n's Customer Success organization continues to grow. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 👥 People leadership: You have 2–3+ years of people management experience, with a strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining Customer Success talent. 💼 7-10 years of experience in Customer Success, Professional Services, Account Management, or other customer-facing roles, including supporting large, complex, high-risk enterprise customers. 💻 Tech industry experience and relevant Enterprise subject-matter expertise: You’ve worked in an enterprise IT or technology environment and understand the needs and expectations of technical buyers and customers. 📊 Operational discipline: You’re comfortable running forecasts, account-health cadences, and structured risk reviews to keep a complex book of business on track. 🛠️ Builder mindset: You thrive in environments where not everything is already defined and are willing to roll up your sleeves to solve problems directly. 🤝 Low-ego collaboration: You enjoy working within a shared direction, partnering closely with peers, and improving existing processes. Nice-to-haves 🚀 High-growth leadership trajectory: You've progressed from a senior CSM role into first-line leadership and have demonstrated strong potential to take on increasing scope. 🤖 Automation and AI familiarity: You're familiar with n8n or the broader automation and AI tooling ecosystem. 🏗️ Leadership across environments: You've held Customer Success leadership responsibilities across more than one company and have seen different approaches to scaling teams. Why join us? At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to own and shape a new leadership layer in our EMEA Customer Success organization. Our EMEA CS team has grown from 1 to 9 people this year, and you'll lead it through its next stage of growth, working with some of our largest and most technically sophisticated enterprise customers. Help shape the future of Life & Pensions through strategic transformation and innovation.

The Role

We are looking for a Managing Principal Consultant with deep Life & Pensions expertise to support and deliver high-impact projects for our UK clients. This role blends strategic leadership, delivery, and hands-on consulting across digital transformation, data, regulatory change, customer transformation, and AI-enabled business transformation. What We're Looking For

  • Strong track record delivering large-scale transformation programmes and complex change initiatives.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience supporting agile transformation initiatives and product ownership.

Why Join Capco

  • Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

description:
Growth at United Media

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why United Media

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

description: At Montu, every department plays an important role in delivering exceptional patient care. From our clinical and pharmacy teams to the people working behind the scenes, we all share the same goal of ensuring our patients receive the care, treatment and support they need. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Coordinator, to join our Operations team at Kings Cross. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference. With thousands of patients relying on our service, getting the little things right really does matter. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of a team that is helping to shape the future of medical cannabis in the UK. This is a full-time, working 40 hours per week. About the Role As a Prescription Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting our patients, clinicians and pharmacy teams, helping to ensure prescriptions are managed accurately and efficiently throughout the patient journey. Working as part of our busy Operations team, you will be responsible for maintaining patient records, responding to enquiries, coordinating with internal and external teams and ensuring patients are kept informed about their prescriptions. This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are quite the same. You will need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and patient care. What You Will Be Doing Responding to patient enquiries via telephone and email, providing a friendly, professional and helpful service. Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic patient records and prescription information. Working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to ensure prescriptions are processed efficiently and medication reaches patients without unnecessary delays. Keeping patients informed of any changes or updates relating to their prescriptions. Liaising with external pharmacy partners to ensure prescriptions are received, dispensed and delivered correctly. Supporting our clinicians with day-to-day operational queries and ensuring they have the information they need. Assisting with operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities when required. Recording and escalating patient feedback, complaints, incidents and significant events in line with company procedures. Working with our Governance team to ensure concerns are appropriately documented and addressed. Liaising with our Product and Technology teams to help resolve technical issues affecting patients or clinicians. Identifying opportunities to improve processes and working collaboratively with colleagues to make our service even better. Maintaining compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures and mandatory training. Supporting the wider team with operational activities and attending relevant meetings as required. Demonstrating flexibility to support shift-based working when required. What You Will Need At least two years of experience in an administrative, customer service or operational role. Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records. Strong communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner. A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others. Good IT skills and the confidence to learn new systems and technology. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, compliance and following established procedures. A proactive, adaptable attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to the continued improvement of our service. What We Offer Competitive salary 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays 5% matched pension contribution Enhanced maternity and paternity pay Cycle-to-work scheme Opportunities for professional development and career progression The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business in an exciting and evolving area of healthcare A collaborative and supportive working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued About Montu Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care. As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK. Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support. description:
Principal AI Engineer (AI / .NET Core / React)

At Mitratech, we’re a team of engineers passionate about building world-class products that empower Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR professionals at Fortune 100 companies. We thrive in a global, inclusive culture that values innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence.

With continued growth, we’re looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join our HotDocs Team. HotDocs is Mitratech’s flagship document automation platform, used by enterprise clients worldwide to streamline the assembly of complex legal documents and contracts.

You'll set the technical direction for AI at HotDocs - designing and delivering new AI-powered enterprise capabilities and driving our adoption of AI across the software development lifecycle. This is a remote-first role.

 

About the Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will:

  •       Set the AI Technical Direction: Own the architecture for AI capabilities across HotDocs - model management, LLM and agent orchestration, retrieval strategy, evaluation, cost and latency management - and translate it into a pragmatic delivery roadmap.
  •       Deliver Enterprise AI Features: Take new AI-powered features from prototype to production at enterprise scale, writing clean, maintainable code in .NET Core and React and holding the bar for performance, security, and readability.
  •       Drive AI Adoption in the SDLC: Lead how we use AI across engineering - coding assistants, agentic workflows, test generation, code review, and documentation - selecting tooling, defining safe and effective usage patterns, and measuring the impact on delivery.
  •       Build Trustworthy AI: Establish evaluation harnesses, guardrails, observability, and AI governance practices so that AI features are accurate, explainable, and safe for use in regulated, compliance-heavy environments.
  •       Bring Deep Technical Expertise: Apply strong .NET and React ecosystem knowledge to complex problems, modernize and refactor legacy code where it blocks AI integration, and improve system scalability and reliability.
  •       Lead and Mentor: Raise the AI capability of the wider engineering group through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, brown-bag sessions, and clear written guidance.
  •       Influence Across the Business: Partner with product management, architecture, security, and customer-facing teams to shape the AI roadmap, evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, and set realistic expectations for what AI can deliver.
  •       Enhance DevOps and AI Ops: Extend CI/CD pipelines to cover AI workloads - prompt and model versioning, automated evaluation gates, monitoring, and cost tracking - working closely with DevOps engineers.
  •       Focus on the User: Ensure AI features solve real customer problems and deliver a great experience through attention to detail, responsiveness, transparency, and accessibility.

 

About You

You are:

  •       A Technical Leader: You set direction without needing authority, build consensus across teams, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical peers.
  •       An AI Practitioner, not a Spectator: You have shipped AI features to real users, keep pace with a fast-moving field, and can tell genuine capability from hype.
  •       Evidence-Led: You care about maintainable code, testing, and measurable outcomes - you evaluate AI systems with data rather than intuition.
  •       Adaptable and Pragmatic: You balance long-term architectural goals with the practical needs of a sprint-driven environment, and you know when a simple solution beats a model.
  •       Security-, Privacy- and Performance-Minded: You build with scalability and resilience in mind, using secure-by-design principles, and you treat data privacy and responsible AI as first-order concerns.

 

Required Skills and Experience

  •       12 or more years of professional software development experience, including time in a principal, lead, or staff-level technical role.
  •       Strong skills in .NET Core (C#) and React (TypeScript) or similar SPA frameworks - this remains a hands-on engineering role.
  •       Demonstrable experience designing and shipping production AI solutions - LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, and agentic or tool-calling systems.
  •       Hands-on experience with cloud AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, or equivalent) and with orchestration frameworks such as Semantic Kernel.
  •       Experience building and maintaining REST APIs.
  •       Proficiency with Entity Framework and Azure SQL (or SQL Server).
  •       Experience evaluating and improving AI system quality - test sets, benchmarking, human review loops, and handling non-deterministic behavior.
  •       Understanding of web applications and AI-specific security, including secure coding, prompt injection, and safe handling of sensitive customer data.
  •       Experience using Git and collaborating through modern workflows (e.g., pull requests, branching strategies).
  •       Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar).
  •       Comfortable working in agile teams using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  •       Practical experience using AI tooling within the SDLC (e.g. coding assistants, agentic developer tools) and a view on how to adopt it well across a team.
  •       A track record of technical leadership - mentoring senior engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing roadmap and architecture decisions.

 

Nice to Have

  •       Deeper AI specialism in areas such as SLMs and fine-tuning, CAG, vector databases, AI observability, multi-agent systems, or AI/ML pipelines.
  •       Experience with Microsoft Office Addins (office.js / VSTO)
  •       Familiarity of .NET Framework / WPF
  •       Experience with authentication standards such as OAuth and SSO.
  •       Exposure to distributed caching (e.g., Redis)
  •       Knowledge of Linux environments and containerization (Docker).
  •       Scripting in PowerShell.
  •       Familiarity with performance tuning and application diagnostics.
  •       Experience with infrastructure-as-code or automation tooling.
  •       Previous experience in enterprise SaaS or compliance-heavy domains (e.g., legaltech, fintech), particularly applying AI to document, contract, or natural language workloads.

 

What We Offer

  •       A collaborative, supportive, and learning-focused work culture.
  •       The chance to shape an AI strategy end to end, from architecture through to production, at enterprise scale.
  •       Opportunities to grow your technical skills and career path.
  •       Remote-first flexibility with optional in-person collaboration sessions.
  •       Competitive benefits and a chance to impact how global organizations automate critical legal and compliance workflows.

 

Join Us

Ready to lead the application of AI to document automation at enterprise scale? Apply now to join Mitratech’s innovative, inclusive, and driven HotDocs engineering team.
