description: 1043 - Data Engineer (Neo4j/Cypher/Knowledge Graphs) · Semi-Senior · Remoto · Argentina Ubicación: Argentina Modalidad: 100% remoto Tipo de contratación: Relación de dependencia (full-time) Industria / Proyecto: LegalTech / Inteligencia Legal y Regulatoria con IA Zona horaria: Argentina (ART / UTC-3) Seniority: Semi-Senior (3 a 5 años de experiencia) Conocé Darwoft En Darwoft desarrollamos software que genera impacto real. Somos una compañía tecnológica latinoamericana que trabaja junto a empresas de diferentes partes del mundo, creando soluciones digitales innovadoras, escalables y de alto valor. Nuestra cultura combina excelencia técnica, colaboración, aprendizaje continuo y una fuerte orientación a las personas. La Inteligencia Artificial forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar, innovar y resolver problemas. Buscamos incorporar nuevas tecnologías para construir mejores productos y potenciar las capacidades de nuestros equipos. Si te apasiona la tecnología, disfrutás resolver desafíos complejos y querés participar en proyectos donde tu trabajo tenga impacto, nos encantaría conocerte. Sobre el rol Estamos buscando un/a Data Engineer Semi-Senior con experiencia práctica en Neo4j, Cypher y modelado de datos en grafos para sumarse a un proyecto innovador de LegalTech enfocado en transformar la manera en que se organiza, conecta y consulta información legal, tributaria, contable y regulatoria. Vas a participar en el desarrollo y evolución de un Knowledge Graph que permitirá relacionar grandes volúmenes de información, identificar conexiones semánticas y potenciar soluciones de búsqueda inteligente basadas en Inteligencia Artificial. Esta posición combina Data Engineering, Graph Databases e Inteligencia Artificial, con un fuerte enfoque en la construcción de soluciones productivas, escalables y mantenibles. Trabajarás junto a equipos de Data Science, Backend e IA para transformar modelos conceptuales, taxonomías y ontologías en estructuras de grafos eficientes que alimenten arquitecturas de recuperación de información como RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Buscamos una persona con una base sólida en ingeniería de datos, experiencia real trabajando con Neo4j y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en Knowledge Graphs, búsqueda semántica y GraphRAG. ¿Qué vas a hacer? Modelado de grafos: Diseñar, implementar y mantener modelos de datos en Neo4j, representando entidades, relaciones, jerarquías y estructuras complejas de información. Ingeniería de datos: Construir y optimizar pipelines ETL/ELT para ingesta, transformación, validación y actualización de datos estructurados y no estructurados. Desarrollo con Cypher: Crear y optimizar consultas complejas para recuperación de información, navegación de relaciones y procesamiento de datos en grafos. Implementación de Knowledge Graphs: Transformar taxonomías, ontologías y modelos conceptuales definidos por Data Science en estructuras productivas dentro de Neo4j. Integración con IA y RAG: Participar en la integración de Neo4j con embeddings, búsqueda vectorial y arquitecturas de recuperación semántica. Optimización de performance: Mejorar consultas, estrategias de indexación, consistencia de datos y escalabilidad de la base de grafos. Integración con Backend: Desarrollar integraciones mediante Python o Node.js para conectar los datos del grafo con aplicaciones, APIs y servicios internos. Calidad de datos: Implementar validaciones, controles automatizados y buenas prácticas para garantizar la integridad y confiabilidad de la información. Trabajo interdisciplinario: Colaborar con especialistas en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial y desarrollo de software para evolucionar la arquitectura de datos. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia profesional en Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering o posiciones similares. Neo4j: Experiencia práctica diseñando, implementando y manteniendo soluciones basadas en bases de datos de grafos. Cypher: Buen dominio del lenguaje para desarrollar consultas complejas, recorrer relaciones y optimizar operaciones sobre grafos. Modelado de datos: Conocimiento de modelos Property Graph, nodos, relaciones, labels, propiedades y buenas prácticas de diseño. ETL/ELT: Experiencia desarrollando pipelines de ingesta, transformación e integración de datos. Programación: Manejo de Python o Node.js para procesamiento de datos, automatización o integración con servicios. Optimización: Conocimiento de índices, constraints, optimización de consultas y performance de bases de datos. Arquitectura de datos: Capacidad para transformar requerimientos funcionales y técnicos en modelos de datos escalables y mantenibles. Fundamentos de IA: Familiaridad con embeddings, búsqueda semántica, bases vectoriales o conceptos de RAG. Autonomía y colaboración: Capacidad analítica, resolución de problemas, documentación técnica y buena comunicación con equipos interdisciplinarios. Será un plus Experiencia con Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG o arquitecturas de recuperación híbrida. Conocimiento de Neo4j APOC, Graph Data Science (GDS) o Neo4j Vector Index. Familiaridad con tecnologías semánticas como RDF, OWL, SKOS o SHACL. Experiencia integrando Neo4j con LangChain, LlamaIndex u otros frameworks de IA. Experiencia con Neo4j AuraDB, despliegues cloud o entornos contenerizados. Conocimiento de NLP, extracción de entidades, procesamiento documental o enriquecimiento semántico. Familiaridad con Kafka, RabbitMQ o herramientas de procesamiento distribuido. Experiencia implementando pruebas automatizadas sobre grafos, validaciones de calidad de datos o herramientas de observabilidad. Experiencia previa en proyectos de LegalTech, RegTech, compliance o plataformas de gestión de conocimiento. ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Darwoft? Contrato full-time en relación de dependencia con pago en ARS. Trabajo 100% remoto. Salario competitivo. Licencias legales y vacaciones. Días personales adicionales al año. Acceso a plataformas de aprendizaje. Tarjeta de beneficios y descuentos. Welcome kit. Programas de reintegros. Clases de inglés. Programa de referidos. Regalo de cumpleaños. Healthy Break. Celebraciones al estilo Darwoft: aniversarios, fiestas de fin de año, cumpleaños y actividades de integración. Conocé esta y otras oportunidades en: Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows. description: About Sayari: Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv. About the Role Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do. The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard. You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it. Why This Role Exists Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it. Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can. What You Will Do Own the analytical relationship, end to end Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering. Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training. Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal. Build with Field Engineering and Product Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission. When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it. Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached. Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows. Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further. Build the tradecraft Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material. Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it. Support Go-To-Market Teams Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact. Who You Are Required A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet. Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT. Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles. Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against. Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives. Desired Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs. Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts. For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

description: Who we are: Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. About the Role: We are seeking a seasoned Associate General Counsel, Commercial to lead the legal function behind Motive's revenue, partnerships, and procurement as the company scales globally. This is a senior, high-visibility role: you will be the trusted legal advisor to our CRO, CFO, and Procurement leaders, helping them move fast and take smart risks across the contract lifecycle. This is a player-coach role. You will build and lead a team of attorneys and contract managers, and mentoring and developing junior attorneys will be a core part of the job. You will stay close to the work by personally drafting and negotiating the most complex and strategic deals. You will also be a builder of systems, creating playbooks, approval matrices, and deal desk processes, and bringing an AI-first approach to legal work. You will report to the VP, Legal and play a central role in shaping the legal team's strategic impact and operational excellence. What You'll Do: Serve as the senior legal partner to the CRO, CFO, and Procurement leadership, advising on deal strategy and balancing speed against risk. Lead the negotiation of complex enterprise, strategic, and reseller agreements, including MSAs, SaaS and hardware/software bundles, SLAs, warranty, and data and security terms, and personally draft and negotiate the highest-impact deals. Structure and negotiate strategic partnerships, resellers, OEM and integration arrangements, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions. Support international expansion, including local entity setup, regional partners and distributors, localized contract frameworks, and coordination with local counsel across the EU, UK, APAC, LATAM, and other regions. Lead procurement and supply chain legal for technology, manufacturing, and logistics vendors. Build and manage a team of attorneys and contract managers. Actively mentor and develop junior attorneys through coaching, delegation, and regular feedback, setting clear career paths and growing the next generation of legal leaders. Create and maintain contract playbooks, fallback and approval matrices, templates, and deal desk processes that let the business scale efficiently and consistently. Drive an AI-first approach to legal work by deploying AI-assisted drafting, redlining, and review, CLM automation, and intake and triage workflows, along with self-service templates and tiered approval thresholds. Track and report on the impact of the function, including cycle time, cost per contract, and outside counsel spend, and manage outside counsel effectively. What We're Looking For: Senior commercial legal depth. 15+ years of total experience across law firm and in-house practice, including at least 5 years in an in-house leadership role (Associate General Counsel, Deputy General Counsel, or Head of Commercial Legal) at a company of scale. Top-tier pedigree. In-house experience at a recognized high-growth or category-leading technology company (SaaS, IoT, hardware, marketplace, or platform), paired with a top law firm background. Proven revenue impact and global growth. Supported a company's growth in revenue to $1B+ in annual revenue or ARR, including growth driven by international expansion. Experience on individual deals and programs worth $50M+ is a plus. Leadership and business partnership. Built and managed teams (a mix of attorneys and contract managers). A trusted advisor to the CRO, CFO, and Procurement leaders who balances speed against risk. You still draft and negotiate personally, with recent experience in the weeds, not just overseeing. Committed mentor and developer of junior attorneys. A track record of structuring, mentoring, and developing attorneys through hands-on coaching, thoughtful delegation, real-time feedback, and clear career paths, and of growing future leaders. You take genuine pride in the people you have developed and see their growth as part of your own success. Full-cycle sales and enterprise contracting. Led negotiation of complex enterprise, strategic, and reseller deals, with a record of shortening sales cycles. Builder of systems and AI-first efficiency. Created contract playbooks, fallback and approval matrices, templates, and deal desk processes. Has adopted AI-first approaches to legal work. A true team player who’s happy to pitch in wherever needed, whether that’s your own deal queue or someone else’s fire drill at quarter-end. Someone who genuinely enjoys working with others, actively shares knowledge, fosters strong working relationships, and can partner with others to achieve shared goals. Someone with a great sense of humor and no ego who shares our vision that the legal team can be both a center of excellence and fun at the same time! **The posted salary range reflects the national range. Candidates located in San Francisco, New York, or Seattle may be eligible for a salary adjustment based on geographic location and experience. Pay Transparency Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits. The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. description: What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. Reports to: VP, Revenue Operations Location: Remote US Compensation Range: $190,000 to $210,000 base plus bonus and equity What You’ll Do: Revenue Readiness owns how Huntress prepares revenue teams to perform. As Director of Revenue Readiness, you will set the vision and build the function that turns company priorities, process changes, product launches, and evolving selling expectations into a coordinated readiness strategy. You will lead across the revenue organization to establish the governance, operating standards, learning systems, and program discipline needed to prepare sellers and frontline managers consistently across roles, segments, motions, and geographies. You will shape priorities with senior GTM leaders, make clear investment and sequencing decisions, and lead your team and cross-functional partners through execution. Perfect Imperfection guides how you work. You create enough structure to scale while continuing to learn and improve the model. You Give a $h*t about whether people are genuinely prepared to perform. You bring Candor when ownership or expectations are unclear, build trust by giving more than we take, and demonstrate Warrior Spirit as you lead meaningful organizational change. You are Outcome-Obsessed about building organizational readiness that helps Huntress execute its growth priorities. Responsibilities: Set and lead the global Revenue Readiness vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap, aligned with Huntress's growth priorities and the capabilities revenue teams need to execute them. Serve as the senior functional leader for Revenue Readiness, advising GTM executives on organizational preparedness, capability needs, investment priorities, and the risks associated with major business changes. Own the Revenue Readiness portfolio and make decisions about priorities, sequencing, capacity, and resource allocation based on business impact and the organization's ability to absorb change. Build the foundational readiness infrastructure for Huntress, including program intake and prioritization, learning governance, delivery standards, reinforcement expectations, content lifecycle management, platform administration, and measurement. Establish a consistent readiness architecture across new hire onboarding, role-based ramp, frontline manager readiness, major business changes, and ongoing development. Create a scalable process for translating identified business needs, performance gaps, product launches, system changes, and new go-to-market expectations into structured readiness programs. Partner with Sales Ops Business Partners to understand prioritized business needs and define the capabilities, behaviors, and measures of preparedness required to address them. Establish clear ownership across Revenue Readiness, Sales Ops Business Partners, Sales Leaders, Product Marketing, GTM Systems, Technical Sales, and other subject matter experts. Revenue Readiness owns program architecture and operationalization, domain experts own subject matter accuracy, and Sales Leaders own coaching, reinforcement, and team execution. Lead the planning and orchestration of company-level readiness initiatives, aligning senior stakeholders on objectives, ownership, timing, reinforcement, and measures of success. Set direction and accountability for the operational health of the learning ecosystem, including the LMS, learning calendars, program records, learner communications, reporting, and content standards. Use those insights to improve programs and guide future investment while maintaining Sales Leader accountability for business performance. Build, lead, and develop the Revenue Readiness team. Represent Revenue Readiness in senior GTM planning and decision-making, ensuring major initiatives account for the time, support, and reinforcement teams need to adopt change successfully. You can lead a team and senior stakeholders through meaningful organizational change, creating clarity, building alignment, and establishing the priorities, governance, and operating practices needed for a scalable Revenue Readiness function. You use data and judgment to evaluate preparedness, identify readiness risks, improve programs, and communicate investment tradeoffs to senior leaders. You can orchestrate multi-step AI workflows and reusable systems that improve analysis, program development, learning operations, prioritization, and decision quality while applying sound judgment to the outputs. description: At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do. NerdWallet is looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical direction for bringing NerdWallet's financial guidance into the AI assistants consumers already use. More and more people start their financial decisions with a conversation instead of a search. We want NerdWallet's trusted guidance to be there when they do. You'll architect and build NerdWallet's apps and integrations on leading third-party AI platforms. That means production LLM-backed systems that run inside environments we don't control: they have to stay accurate, grounded in trusted content, and compliant in a highly regulated domain, while adapting to fast-moving platform capabilities, protocols, and policies. You'll be the senior technical voice across the platform integration teams and partner closely with the team that owns the shared services these integrations run on. This is a hands-on role. The ideal candidate writes a lot of code, sets the architectural bar, and makes the engineers around them better. You're a staff engineer who is energized by building on brand-new platforms where the playbook doesn't exist yet. You'll turn ambiguous product bets into clear technical plans, then build the critical parts yourself. You'll define how NerdWallet shows up across multiple AI platforms, balancing what should be shared against what needs to be platform-specific so each team can move fast and independently. You're a trusted technical advisor to Engineering Managers and Product Managers, you raise the quality bar through design and code review, and you mentor engineers on building reliable systems on top of non-deterministic models. You stay close to the rapidly changing AI ecosystem and help NerdWallet decide where to invest. This role reports to the Director, Engineering. Where you can make an impact: Lead the technical direction for AI platform integrations. Own the architecture for how NerdWallet's guidance is packaged, exposed, and rendered inside third-party AI assistants, from tool and protocol design to in-conversation UI. Build a lot of it yourself. Write production code for new integrations, prototype new platform capabilities as they launch, and unblock teams on the hardest technical problems. Design for reuse across platforms. Define the abstractions, contracts, and patterns that let multiple platform teams share a common foundation while still using each platform's unique features. Adapt as platforms change. Track evolving platform protocols, SDKs, review processes, and policies. Turn those changes into roadmap and architecture decisions before they become blockers. Make quality measurable. Help define eval and testing strategy for platform integrations, including automated evals, regression suites, and end-to-end tests across environments you don't fully control. Build safely for a regulated domain. Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance so integrations handle authentication, consent, and sensitive consumer data correctly and follow financial compliance requirements. Own reliability and performance. Set standards for monitoring, latency, cost, and incident response on platform-facing services, and help resolve production issues when they happen. Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, set coding and architecture standards, and conduct code reviews that model what good looks like. Mentor and multiply. Coach engineers across FTE and contractor teams on system design, LLM-backed development, and good engineering practices. Partner with leadership on the roadmap. Work with Engineering Managers and Product to shape priorities, estimate effort and risk honestly, and recommend where to place technical bets. Use data to guide decisions. Dig into usage and performance data to find where integrations are working, where they aren't, and what to build next. Your experience: 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 3+ years at the Staff level and deep hands-on experience building and operating production backend systems. A track record of technical leadership: architecting complex systems end to end, leading a team through hard technical problems, establishing best practices, and mentoring other engineers. Hands-on experience building production features on LLMs: tool use/function calling, MCP or similar protocols, prompt and context design, retrieval (RAG), evals, and handling non-deterministic output. Advanced knowledge of a modern TypeScript stack (e.g., Node.js, React, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis), with the judgment to evaluate unfamiliar codebases, SDKs, and vendor tools. Experience designing APIs and shared services that other teams build on, including versioning, backward compatibility, and balancing competing consumer needs. Experience building on third-party platforms or ecosystems (e.g., app stores, plugin/extension ecosystems, partner APIs) where you work within someone else's constraints and review processes. Strong understanding of authentication and authorization patterns (e.g., OAuth) and security best practices for handling sensitive data. Comfort with early-stage, zero-to-one work where the product, platform, and process are being defined as you go. Strong communication skills: you can explain AI system behavior, tradeoffs, and risk clearly to engineers, product partners, and leadership. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building apps, connectors, or agents for major AI assistant platforms. Experience shipping AI features in regulated industries (fintech, lending, insurance, healthcare), including privacy, consent, and compliance review. Experience with AWS, modern CI/CD, containerization, and observability for LLM systems (tracing, cost and latency monitoring). Experience mentoring engineers across blended FTE and vendor/contractor teams. Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as platforms and user behavior evolve. Where: This role will be remote (based in the U.S.). We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family. What we offer: Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?) Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care Mental health support Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend) Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends) Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too) Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people) 401K with 4% company match Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here. NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in the DACH region: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings. We have offices in Paris and Amsterdam, and offer remote working from Germany, France, the Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. You should apply if You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You’re excited by AI: you’ll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space. You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically. You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before. In this role, you will Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value. Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice. Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost. Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script. Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to. Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce. Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events. Minimum requirements for the role 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written Curious, and able to ask insightful questions A champion of a Growth Mindset Highly proficient in English and fluent in German AI Literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work An ideal candidate also has Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity) Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space. ADR pathways Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels: ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling. ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration. ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. description: StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels. We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Sales – EMEA to lead StackAdapt's sales organization across the UK, Spain, Germany, France and the UAE. This leader will own the regional sales strategy and lead a geographically dispersed team of sales leaders and Sales Managers, with London as the hub and team members in each of our continental European and Middle Eastern markets. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth across independent agencies and brands. In the UK, that means owning new and existing brands and independent agencies. In Spain, Germany, France and the UAE, it means building and scaling markets where teams sell across segments, inclusive of holding companies. The ideal candidate brings deep DSP and programmatic advertising experience, strong relationships across the EMEA advertising ecosystem, and a proven track record of leading high-performing sales organizations across multiple markets. This leader will partner closely with UK Enterprise Sales leadership, Client Services, Agency Development, Marketing, Product, Solutions, Inventory Partnerships, Sales Enablement, Data & Analytics, and Revenue Operations to strengthen StackAdapt's market position and accelerate growth across EMEA. StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, our sales teams operate regionally. For this role, we are prioritising candidates located in the UK or EU, ideally in commutable distance to our London hub. What You'll Be Doing: EMEA Sales Strategy & Growth Own and execute the sales strategy for the UK, Spain, Germany, France and the UAE, with accountability for regional revenue growth, new customer acquisition, and expansion within existing accounts. Develop differentiated strategies, organizational structure, and hiring needs for independent agencies, holding companies, and direct brands, reflecting how each buys and how buying behavior varies across markets. Build market-by-market playbooks. Germany, France, UAE, and Spain each have distinct agency landscapes, buying cycles and privacy expectations. Establish a consistent regional operating rhythm for targets, pipeline health, forecasting, territory strategy and overall sales performance. Partner with Finance, Legal and Deal Desk to maintain deal quality and sustainable commercial terms. Leadership & Team Development Lead and develop a geographically dispersed organization of sales leaders and Account Executives across the UK, continental Europe and the UAE, selling across independent agencies and direct brands. Build leadership depth in each market and set clear expectations, operating rhythms and accountability across time zones and cultures. Recruit, coach and develop high-performing sales talent, including the first local leaders in expansion markets, while fostering a connected regional culture. Support the team on strategic opportunities, complex negotiations and executive customer relationships. Customer & Market Leadership Build executive-level relationships across independent agencies, holding companies, and brands in each market. Partner with UK Enterprise Sales leadership on multi-market and Holding Company accounts, with a clear operating model to ensure a consistent StackAdapt service motion. Serve as a senior DSP and programmatic leader in strategic pitches, platform evaluations and competitive conversations. Represent StackAdapt with senior customers, partners and industry stakeholders across EMEA. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner across UK Enterprise Sales, Client Services, Agency Development, Product, Solutions, Marketing, Inventory Partnerships, Sales Enablement, Data & Analytics and Revenue Operations to execute an integrated EMEA go-to-market strategy. Bring EMEA voice of customer and market insights into company strategy, product development and investment decisions, including regional privacy and data requirements. Use data and market intelligence to identify growth opportunities, improve sales performance and prioritize resources across markets. What You'll Bring to the Table Experience balancing an established core business with building newer markets, and knowing when an account warrants an enterprise approach. Significant sales leadership experience within a demand-side platform (DSP) or directly comparable programmatic advertising business. Deep knowledge of the European and Middle Eastern programmatic advertising ecosystem and how agencies and brands evaluate and adopt DSPs. Proven track record of owning and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple EMEA markets. Demonstrated success selling to independent agencies and direct brands, with exposure to Holding Company structures and agency trading relationships. Experience leading geographically dispersed, multi-country sales teams and sales leaders, including hiring first local leaders in new markets. Understanding of privacy-first selling, including GDPR and consent requirements that shape how brands and agencies buy. Strong operational discipline across forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning and performance management. Comfort working across time zones with North American leadership and regional teams. Executive presence and the ability to influence customers, cross-functional partners and senior leadership. The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. We do not ask candidates about current or prior salary history, and we will not use such information, if volunteered, in setting an offer. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package. Factors Influencing Final Compensation: The final compensation offer will be determined by a variety of factors, which may include, but are not limited to: the candidate's specific experience, technical skills, knowledge, abilities, and relevant education, licensure, and certifications. Other business factors, such as organizational needs and budget alignment, may also be considered in the final offer. Access to a comprehensive mental health care program Health benefits from day one of employment Work from home reimbursements Optional global WeWork membership for those who want a change from their home office and hubs in London and Toronto Robust training and onboarding program Coverage and support of personal development initiatives (conferences, courses, books etc) Access to StackAdapt programmatic courses and certifications to support continuous learning An awesome parental leave program A friendly, welcoming, and supportive culture Our social and team events! Please note: Benefits and perks may vary depending on your country of employment and the nature of your engagement. In locations where StackAdapt does not have a legal entity, employment and benefits are administered in accordance with local regulations and partner policies. No matter who you are, where you are from, who you love, follow in faith, disability, superpower status, ethnicity, or the gender you identify with (if you’re comfortable, let us know your pronouns), you are welcome at StackAdapt. description: About the Role Appen’s Strategic Project Leads turn complex technical requirements into high-quality data and evaluation resources that help advance AI models. As the Strategic Project Lead for Physical Engineering, you will bring deep engineering knowledge to projects involving the physical world and built environment. You will help translate real-world engineering work into structured tasks, expert-reviewed data and evaluations that support AI training and model assessment. You will bring depth in at least one physical engineering discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, civil or structural engineering, while working with specialists across other areas as needed. You will partner with customers, Applied Researchers, Operations and technical experts to shape project requirements, establish quality standards and deliver technically credible results. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead through subject matter expertise and influence, rather than direct people management. Your Impact Translate customer requirements into realistic engineering tasks, data specifications and measurable acceptance criteria. Assess technical requirements, review source files and develop representative samples to establish project feasibility. Shape the physical engineering domain strategy across areas such as CAD, BIM, CAE and electrical engineering. Develop multi-step engineering tasks and reference solutions that reflect real-world technical challenges across models, drawings, calculations and specifications. Lead pilots from sample development and expert onboarding through quality assurance and customer acceptance. Partner with Operations to transition projects into production, maintaining technical standards and ownership of domain quality as delivery scales. Build and qualify a network of specialist engineering contributors and reviewers. Work with Applied Researchers and tooling teams to develop technical verification methods and improve the consistency of engineering evaluations. Provide effort estimates and identify specialist requirements, tooling needs and delivery risks to support commercial proposals. Turn successful projects into reusable engineering samples, task libraries and delivery methods. What You Bring Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in at least one physical engineering discipline, with a background in applied engineering work and technical problem-solving. Practical experience with engineering tools and CAE workflows, including interpreting analyses and validating assumptions, constraints and results. Experience working with technical artefacts such as CAD or BIM models, engineering drawings, schematics, calculations, simulations or specifications. Experience leading technical projects from initial scoping and estimation through execution and delivery, with direct involvement in the technical work. Ability to evaluate engineering outputs, identify technical inaccuracies and establish quality standards and acceptance criteria. Experience assessing or guiding technical specialists, with the judgement to recognise when additional expertise is required. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear instructions and lead cross-functional teams. Nice to Have Master's or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related technical discipline. Experience developing engineering data, technical tasks or evaluation resources for AI training, model evaluation or benchmarking. Familiarity with CAD/BIM interoperability, open engineering formats or structured validation of engineering models and documentation. Experience building specialist contributor networks or leading distributed technical delivery with external engineering experts. Why You'll Love Working Here At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models. You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time. About Appen Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion. description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of clinical trials by independently managing clinical site monitoring and site management activities across Spain and Portugal, from study start-up through close-out. You will act as a primary point of contact for investigative sites in these countries, ensuring compliance with protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations and study requirements while supporting high-quality patient data and study delivery. This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for supporting site performance, resolving issues, maintaining study documentation and providing guidance and mentorship to junior CRAs. You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, sponsors and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic clinical research environment. Key Responsibilities: Independently conduct and document onsite and remote monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits across Portugal and Spain. Ensure investigative sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and project-specific requirements. Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned sites, managing site-related questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations through to resolution. Review clinical trial data, source documentation and study systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity and compliance. Support site selection, activation and recruitment activities, working with sites to achieve study milestones and patient recruitment targets. Ensure sites are appropriately trained on protocols, study systems, processes and applicable requirements throughout the study lifecycle. Maintain oversight of essential study documentation, including ISF and TMF, ensuring documents are complete, accurate and filed in a timely manner. Collaborate with sponsors, project teams, vendors and investigative sites to support study timelines, resolve issues and maintain effective working relationships. Participate in audits and inspections, Investigator Meetings, study meetings and other project activities as required. Provide mentoring and support to CRA I and II colleagues, participate in co-monitoring and CRA assessment activities, and contribute to process improvement initiatives. Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (Honours) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is preferred. 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience, with 7–9 years preferred. Strong clinical site monitoring experience across clinical trial activities from site start-up through close-out. Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research principles and applicable local regulatory requirements. Experience with Phase I–IV clinical trials preferred. Proficiency with clinical trial systems such as EDC, IRT, eTMF, CTMS and Microsoft Office, with experience in systems such as Medidata Rave or Oracle InForm preferred. Strong understanding of site management, including site activation, recruitment, training, issue resolution and maintenance of essential documentation. Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigative sites, sponsors and cross-functional teams. Strong organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a sense of urgency. Ability to work independently, demonstrate sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment. Experience mentoring or supporting junior CRAs is preferred. Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project requirements and geographic location. Valid driver’s licence required. Fluent written and verbal English, Spanish and Portuguese What We Offer In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs: Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility) One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.) Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year! Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. Our Services End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading Precision medicine and biomarker solutions Real-world evidence and clinical consulting Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio How to Apply To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English. Equal Opportunity and Accessibility Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com. Compensation Additional Information Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process. Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.
